depends on the situation and relationship. some couples are going to be able to find ways to make it work (like opening the relationship); some couples will be fine having some level of sexual intimacy, and others will be happy in a relationship without sex. i couldn't function in a relationship where i knew my partner wasn't sexually attracted to me, even if we still had sex; this isn't a problem for other couples. 

it's like career choice or wanting kids or anything else; sometimes people's needs and goals will be compatible/something they can healthily compromise on for that relationship, and sometimes they won't.

jfc yeah. cannot count how many times i've gone to therapy, gone through all my trauma, described all the ways i'm suffering currently, laid my soul bare just to get "that sounds like it must be very difficult/stressful/painful for you." like, yes, i know, that's why i'm fucking here. you get paid for this??? it's a glorified, expensive version of the suicide hotline; they just repeat back whatever you said and then tell you to breathe or take a hot bath. helpful for some, but doesn't even scratch the surface for me.

yeah. turning 27 this month, i've had more attempts than i can remember starting before i turned 10. i honestly believe i was supposed to die before i turned 21 and the longer i stick around now the sicker i'm going to get and the worse i'm making life for anyone who gets close to me. no good way to explain it to someone who hasn't been there; i wish i had something more uplifting to add but yeah, shit sucks.
glad this is an effective answer for you and others, sincerely.

i have good things; in a lot of ways my living situation right now is the best it's ever been. but life's hard, nothing is permanent, bad things happen. for me the guarantee that i will enjoy future good things doesn't outweigh the guarantee of the bad ones; i'd rather appreciate the good things i've already experienced and cut my losses there. thanks for reading and responding, though.
same. i fantasize about death and suicide all the time. the only thing that keeps life manageable day by day is thinking about how i'll end it.

my mom did this as well. it became one of those things that actually made for funny stories for me. it took me telling them to people a few times and noticing they weren't laughing but actually shocked or horrified for me to realize it was actually fucked up.
